questions.question:
Two Statements are given followed by two conclusions numbered I and II. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

Some Blankets are Bedsheets.

Some Bedsheets are Pillows.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some Blankets are Pillows.

II. All Bedsheets can never be Pillows.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follow.
Neither conclusion I nor II follow.

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a15dfbc293cbb673af95c813df5c2aa3ded5fbc6c00655092061a2c32c009ecc.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some Blankets are Pillows → False (Some Blankets are Bedsheets and Some Bedsheets are Pillows so, Some Blankets are Pillows is false)

II. All Bedsheets can never be Pillows → False (Some Bedsheets are Pillows so, All Bedsheets can never be Pillows is not definite)

∴ Here, Both conclusions I and II are false.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Neither conclusion I nor II follow".**

questions.question:
If A denotes 'addition', B denotes 'multiplication', C denotes 'subtraction', and D denotes 'division', then what will be the value of the following equation?

7 B 3 C 18 A (4 D 2) = ?
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is :-

By using BODMAS RULE :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e50723751bca1df33fc1f030f78c1eac3344f2cdb432474cd432c6df783a12ab.png] 

 
 

 Alphabet
 A
 B
 C
 D
 
 

 Means
 +
 × 
 -
 ÷ 
 
 

The given expression : 7 B 3 C 18 A (4 D 2) = ?

After interchanging the symbols by mathematical operators the expression is as follows : 7 × 3 - 18 + (4 ÷ 2)

= 7 × 3 - 18 + __**(4 ÷ 2)**__

= __**7 × 3**__ - 18 + 2

= __**21**__ - 18 __**+ 2**__

= __**23 - 18**__

= **5**

Hence, the correct answer is **"5".**

questions.question:
In the following question below are given some statements followed by some conclusions based on those statements. Taking the given statements to be true even if they seem to be at variance from commonly known facts. Read all the conclusions and then decide which of the given conclusion logically follows the given statements.

**Statements:**

I. All land are solid.

II. No land is boy.

**Conclusion:**

I. All solid are land.

II. All boy are solid.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follows

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram is: 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/974eef1c412086e3c14c6e5bf82cbc4a0dba20449460fa9f7c28c76507b9aee0.png] 

Conclusion:

I. All solid are land. → Does not follow (As, All land are solid → Some solid are land)

II. All boy are solid. → Does not follow (As, All land are solid and No land is boy → Some boy are not solid)

Hence, '**Neither conclusion follows**' is the correct answer.

questions.question:
After interchanging the given two signs and two numbers, what will be the value of the given equation?

+ and ÷, 4 and 6; 8 ÷ 6 × 3 + 4 - 9
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f17fe402f98bb01e6c434026861e42229a2db5fdddb9ac339c012f7a2b73afa8.png] 

After interchanging the given two signs and two numbers, + and ÷, 4 and 6

8 + 4 × 3 ÷ 6 - 9

= 8 + 4 × __**3 **____**÷**____** 6**__ - 9

= 8 + __**4 **____**× 0.5**__ - 9

= __**8 + 2**__ - 9

= __**10 - 9**__

= 1

Hence, '**1**' is the correct answer.

questions.question: Five friends Mahi, Mili, Milan, Manas, and Monika sit on a bench facing north. Only Mahi is sitting between Mili and Monika. Manas sits to the immediate left of Mili. Manas is not at the end. Who sits to the immediate right of Milan?
questions.solution:
**Given :** Five friends Mahi, Mili, Milan, Manas, and Monika sit on a bench facing north.

**Explanation :**

1) Only Mahi is sitting between Mili and Monika.

2) Manas sits to the immediate left of Mili.

As position of Mahi is not known yet, therefore there are two possible positions.

After positioning Mahi, Mili, Monika and Manas only one position is left which will be occupied by the only person left i.e Milan.

 
• Case - (1) :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/502d239419cf69c1617807247087290dbddddf433f2899dd0438c996cae70af4.png] 

 
• Case - (2) :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8552cb4175b7c52ca1b9420dd90df43b1c8db9e9799176db705a82847f3ec942.png] 

3) Manas is not at the end.

As Manas cannot be positioned at any of the ends, therefore case - (1) is eliminated.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8552cb4175b7c52ca1b9420dd90df43b1c8db9e9799176db705a82847f3ec942.png] 

Thus, according to the final arrangement Manas sits to the immediate right of Milan.

Hence, **"Manas"** is the correct answer.
